definition: Put one card from your hand onto the end of your Line.
window: Your turn: once, plus one more per Stop Time that resolves.
does: Places the card and opens the opponent's Interrupt window. It is the provenance event.
does_not: Does not by itself gain Glow or apply the effect; that is Resolve.

contrast.resolve: Play is the act of placing; Resolve is the result being applied.
contrast.interrupt: An Interrupt is a play made on the opponent's turn, in response.
